reported.quote: Consolidated revenues grew by 39% year-on-year, supported by sustained momentum across both our wires and cables and FMEG businesses.
EBITDA increased by 32% year-on-year and the margins stood at 13.8%, reflecting an improvement of approximately 70 basis points sequentially over the previous quarter.
At the bottom line, we achieved our highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax of INR 7,967 million, representing a growth of 33% year-on-year.
The Wires & Cables segment registered a healthy 39% year-on-year growth during the quarter.
The FMEG segment delivered another outstanding quarter, recording 71% year-on-year growth with strong contributions across all product categories.
Capital expenditure during the quarter amounted to INR 3.2 billion, reflecting our continued commitment to building capacity and strengthening future growth drivers.

business: Polycab India Limited manufactures and sells wires and cables, and operates a fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) business encompassing fans, lighting, switches, switchgears, solar products, and conduit pipes. The company also undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects.
